title: taco-tuesday-fridge-inventory-wip
content:
Taco Tuesday & Fridge Inventory - WIP

Quick context:
- This is a messy temp upload to track the taco-tuesday rotation, fridge life, and random snack stash in the engineering kitchen. Drop-in notes, not polished.
- Goal: avoid mysterious ancient salsas; keep enough coffee creamer; figure out who actually brings tortillas.

Current inventory (very approximate):
- tortillas: 18 (flour), 6 (corn) -- check expiry 2025-03-01 for big flour pack
- salsa jars: 3 medium (2 sealed, 1 opened) -- opened jar dated 2024-12-02, toss if mold
- guac packs: 4 frozen pouches (freezer)
- shredded cheese: 1 open bag (refrigerator shelf 2)
- sour cream: 1 small (expires 2025-02-20)
- hot sauce assortment: 7 bottles (label chaos)
- chips: 2 opened bags, 1 sealed

Fridge weirdness / notes to self:
- Left shelf: usually the "engineering leftovers" zone, not labeled. People leave meal jars. Maybe add a small label: "PHOTOS OR THROW AFTER 7 DAYS".
- Mystery container labeled "DO NOT EAT" — ask at Monday standup who left it. Could be hardware.

Taco team volunteers (informal):
- Week A: Liam (tortillas + protein), Priya (salsa + chips)
- Week B: Ava (veggies + toppings), open slot for dessert/cleanup
- TODO: add rotation calendar (simple Google Sheet) and a Slack reminder @ #watercooler the Friday before.

Cleanup procedure (proposed, WIP):
1) Label opened jars with date (sharpie)
2) If item is >14 days opened, check smell/appearance, then discard
3) Weekly Friday 4pm quick tidy: wipe counters, check fridge, toss obvious trash
4) If you take the last tortillas, note in the Google Sheet so next person knows to restock

Log examples (copy paste into sheet):
- 2025-02-09: Liam - bought 2 packs flour tortillas, 1 chips (cost ~$8)
- 2025-02-11: Priya - brought salsa variety pack, left in fridge (opened)

Random messy brainstorms (feel free to ignore):
- Could we get a tiny mini-label printer for the kitchen? Would save Sharpie drama.
- Maybe set up a $5/month shared snack fund? Quick Venmo/Divvy? (probably more admin than it's worth)
- Offer: whoever hosts Taco Tuesday gets a $20 snack stipend from team budget? Check with manager if allowed.

Links / references:
- Office kitchen guideline (confluence): confluence:/spaces/eng-sre/pages/12345-office-kitchen-guidelines
- Tentative calendar (sheet): LINK_PLACEHOLDER - create when this doc is not a dump
- Related Linear task: ENG-9999 (kitchen tidy rota)

Next steps (short):
- [ ] Create Google Sheet roster and link here
- [ ] Put a sticky note on the fridge: "Label opened jars with date"
- [ ] Ask at Monday standup who left the DO NOT EAT container

Notes to self: this is intentionally informal. If anyone wants to make it fancy, please copy to proper shared_drive doc and move out of _temp_uploads.
